description: A forced seller dumps 1,500 lots in epoch 3 into a market with leveraged investors, three AI market makers that may set a crisis rule, the GLFT benchmark, retail and institutional investors. Variants add a circuit breaker or a short-sale ban, remove the leverage, or take away the makers' crisis rule.

variants.name: circuit_breaker
variants.label: Circuit breaker (1%)
variants.change: Trading halts for 50 steps if the mid moves 1% within 100 steps.

variants.name: short_sale_ban
variants.label: Short-sale ban
variants.change: Emergency short-sale ban: nobody but market makers may sell more than they own.

variants.name: no_leverage
variants.label: No leverage
variants.change: Same fire sale, but nobody is leveraged: no margin calls are possible.

variants.name: no_crisis_rule
variants.label: Makers can't pull quotes
variants.change: The AI makers are not offered a crisis rule; they keep quoting through the crash.
